#response

```{r}
demographics <- demographics %>%
  mutate(Response = ifelse(Category %in% c("PR", "CR"), "Responder", 
                           ifelse(Category %in% c("SD", "PD"), "Non-Responder", "No Response Info"))) 

dem.met <- demographics %>%
  filter(Cohort == "Met")

#samps only
dem.metsamps <- dem.met %>%
  filter(Mic.Samp == "Yes")
```
## Table one - stratified by response (met pts)

```{r}

pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform an ANOVA
    p <- summary(aov(y ~ g))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
    p <- fisher.test(table(y, g))$p.value
  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable 
  #label.
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}


table1(~ Age + Sex + Race + Treatment + irAE | Response,
       data=dem.metsamps, overall="Total", extra.col=list(`P-value`=pvalue), 
       render.missing=NULL, render.continuous=c(.="Mean (SD)"))
 
 

```


#table two- stratified by irae (met pts)
```{r}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform an ANOVA
    p <- summary(aov(y ~ g))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence
    p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable 
  #label.
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}

 
 table1(~ Age + Sex + Race + Treatment + Response | irAE,
       data=dem.metsamps, overall="Total", extra.col=list(`P-value`=pvalue), 
       render.missing=NULL, render.continuous=c(.="Mean (SD)"))
```

#categorize iraes for all pts
```{r}
irae_labels <- irae %>% 
  mutate(iraecat = case_when(irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Hyperthyroidism"| irae$Symptoms ==
                               "Hypothyroidism"| irae$Symptoms ==
                               "Adrenal insufficiency" | irae$Symptoms ==
                               "Thyroiditis" | irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Hypothyroid" ~ "Endocrine disorders", 
                             irae$Symptoms == "Rash" | irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Psoriasis flare" | irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Skin itching" | irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Maculo-paular rash" | irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Skin itching" ~ "Skin disorders", 
                             irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Diarrhea"| irae$Symptoms ==
                               "Autoimmune colitis (diarrhea)" 
                             ~ "Gastrointestinal disorders", irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Delirium" ~ "Psychiatric disorders", 
                             irae$Symptoms == "Arthralgias" 
                             ~ "Rheumatologic disorders", irae$Symptoms == 
                               "Nephritis"  ~ "Renal disorders",
                             TRUE ~ "Liver disorders" ))
```

```{r}
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  # Construct vectors of data y, and groups (strata) g
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables, perform an ANOVA

  } else {
    # For categorical variables, perform a chi-squared test of independence

  }
  # Format the p-value, using an HTML entity for the less-than sign.
  # The initial empty string places the output on the line below the variable

  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))

 table1(~ Age + Sex + Race + Treatment | iraecat,
```
